## 1. 当前观察 (observation)

### Scope, units and statistics

- R = unified logloss_bits of the true pairing against the full test candidate pool on the fixed last-70 % query (bits per query; lower = better). ΔR = R(reference) − R(candidate): positive = lower risk with the candidate. ΔR_mm = candidate − reference (mismatched-EEG logloss). Δgain = candidate − reference; per identity Δgain = ΔR + ΔR_mm exactly (§1.4).
- n counts unique test identities. Within a pair (reference → candidate) both sides of an identity are averaged over the same content folds, those admitted on both sides (normally its two content folds; analysis note, addendum 2, C1); partial and missing pairs are counted in §1.6. Seeds, folds and content folds never add n. Bootstrap-t over identities, B = 4,000; [sim.] = simultaneous 95 % by max-t within the family. No p-values.
- Tier exact (none, input_spatial): the refit reproduces the recorded fit (QC §1.8). Tier seeded_refit (output_low_rank): a new seeded fit; its gain differs from the record by the initialisation draw (columns 'refit' vs 'record').

## 2. 当前工作判断 (working interpretation)

Written by the lead agent on 2026-10-17 after viewing §1. Exploratory, new execution version (analysis note `private/auditory_alignment_v3/aln34/DADAPT_R_NOTE.md`); the D_ADAPT gain table of ADDENDUM_12 stays the main table.

- **True-query risk agrees in direction with the recorded unified gain for every NCE input_spatial member, in all three seeds.** Identity means over seeds: FAU 10 % +0.093 [sim. +0.008, +0.177] (I>0; the gain table had this member at "contains 0"), FAU 30 % +0.250 [+0.150, +0.351], DTU 10 % −0.208 [−0.297, −0.118] (I<0 in every seed), DTU 30 % +0.150 [+0.068, +0.233]; more support (10 → 30 %) lowers risk in both datasets (+0.157 and +0.358).
- **The DTU 10 % native "gain" was not a lower true risk.** Native ΔR is −0.595 [−0.750, −0.439] over seeds, although the native gain rose (+0.150): the mismatched loss rose more than the true loss. Both readouts therefore show the same harm when risk, not gain, is the endpoint.
- **output_low_rank** lowers NCE risk modestly (seed 3401: FAU +0.083 / +0.120, DTU +0.039 / +0.062 at 10 / 30 %); under CS_SINGLE its effect is ≤ 0.007 bits. These refits are seeded (the adapters were not saved), so their gains differ from the records by the initialisation draw (columns refit vs record).
- Scope: same-session, known-stimulus supervision; support and query from the same recording; seed 3401 for the full ADDENDUM_12 families, three seeds only for NCE input_spatial. Not label-free adaptation, not cross-session, not a clinical effect.

## 3. 仍竞争的解释 (competing explanations)

- **DTU 10 % harm.** (a) The 64 × 64 input map (4,096 parameters) is under-determined by 4–9 support segments; (b) the step count is chosen once per cell on a 30 % split and native gain, so 10 % support may be over-trained (100 steps in most cells); (c) the earlier candidate "the unified bridge drifts from the adapted representation" is weakened, because the native readout, which uses no bridge, shows the same true-risk harm.
- **FAU vs DTU difference at 10 %.** Different montages (31 vs 64 channels, so 961 vs 4,096 map parameters), recording lengths and support seconds; the two datasets are not compared on a common scale here.
- **output_low_rank small but positive.** Few parameters limit both gain and harm; whether a restricted spatial map (diagonal / low-rank) keeps the 30 % benefit without the 10 % harm is untested.
